summary: Weird to consider never was as gravity kept our rock in motions New notionss of friendship cover old emotions that can Never Hide. Always present. A history itching at a big bite on your softest hide. #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Weird to
consider never was
as gravity kept
our rock in motions
New notionss of friendship
cover old emotions that can
Never Hide.
Always present.
A history itching at a big bite
on your softest hide.
#smallpoems
